about.text: A yeasted tart with a rice-pudding style filling: rice cooked slowly in milk, mixed with egg and baked, then topped with whipped cream and chocolate. Also called rijsttaart, the Dutch page places it especially in the Euregio Maas-Rijn region.

sources.text: The dough, the filling, the bake and the topping, and the region, from the Dutch page.
